name: Kannaka albums (radio + YouTube art, replaces OBC generate-image)
tail: fine art, rich detail, cinematic light, no text
negative: text, letters, words, watermark, signature, artist signature, initials, monogram, handwriting, logo, blurry, deformed, extra limbs, lowres, face, portrait
rules: Each image prompt carries its own style; the tail only adds finish, so a track can keep its own visual idiom.
Kannaka may appear only per the face canon (a classically beautiful queen with long black hair), seen from behind or as a faceless silhouette.
Never any other face: no other person is drawn with a face.
No text, letters, logos, signs or painter signatures anywhere in the image; reject any that has one at visual review.
